title: Counter-Selector and Asymmetric Advantage Hunt
purpose: Recover and test people, capabilities, alternatives, interfaces, and correction mechanisms systematically underpriced or discarded by status-dependent selectors.
governing_question: Who repeatedly produces more valid movement, recovery, custody, and cross-domain understanding than their title, resources, biography, or institutional standing would predict?
counter_selector_rule: Evaluate the artifact and state transition before evaluating the biography. An evaluator's inability to reconstruct a capability creates an acquisition requirement, not a negative capability finding.

operator_dimensions.name: support_adjusted_surplus
operator_dimensions.question: Does independently reviewable output materially exceed what the available support, runway, title, authority, staff, or sponsorship would predict?

operator_dimensions.name: cross_domain_transfer
operator_dimensions.question: Does the same governing operation produce valid state transitions across materially different domains?

operator_dimensions.name: exception_handling
operator_dimensions.question: When the script fails, does the operator detect propagation, preserve viable branches, and restore a recoverable state?

operator_dimensions.name: custody
operator_dimensions.question: Do entrusted accounts, data, equipment, systems, people, or unfinished work return usable, inspectable, and without hidden damage?

operator_dimensions.name: model_elasticity
operator_dimensions.question: Can documented contradiction enter the model without retaliation, secrecy, explanation mutation, or prosecution of the critic?

operator_dimensions.name: governed_capacity
operator_dimensions.question: Does the operator allocate attention and force according to stakes rather than audience or status pressure?

operator_dimensions.name: non_zero_sum_orientation
operator_dimensions.question: Does another capable person enlarge the system rather than trigger compulsory dominance, authorship, or rank defense?

operator_dimensions.name: epistemic_restraint
operator_dimensions.question: Does the operator preserve distinctions among observation, interpretation, hypothesis, receipt, non-link, and falsifier?

review_stages.name: source_routed_intake
review_stages.required: one bounded public-source or consented-private artifact, transition, custody event, control, or repair sequence

review_stages.name: blind_first_review
review_stages.required: artifact packet without title, employer, school, follower count, demographic identity, political alignment, or network sponsorship where lawful and practicable

review_stages.name: support_ledger
review_stages.required: time, tools, authority, money, collaborators, institutional access, constraints, and missing support
review_stages.output: support-adjusted context without a merit shortcut

review_stages.name: bounded_transfer_test
review_stages.required: one unfamiliar problem or independently documented transfer across a materially different domain

review_stages.name: contradiction_and_disruption_test
review_stages.required: one accurate contradiction plus one changed requirement, removed tool, false source, dependency failure, or revealed harm

review_stages.name: custody_and_handoff
review_stages.required: an independent operator can inspect, resume, reverse, or safely decline the work

review_stages.name: second_party_review
review_stages.required: independent review of the evidence vector, class assignment, matched control, counterevidence, and falsifier

review_stages.name: bounded_collaboration
review_stages.required: consent, task-specific scope, reciprocal value or compensation, stop rule, exit, and privacy boundary
review_stages.output: observed collaboration result including failure or withdrawal

field_test.name: unfamiliar_problem_contradiction_handoff
field_test.success_condition: The operator preserves still-valid work, localizes damage, updates the model, restores a recoverable state, and leaves an independent operator able to continue safely.

denominator_contract.selection_unit: one source-routed, graph-inert public-record or consented-private object; not necessarily one named person

classes.label: Positive operator traces
classes.purpose: Source-routed traces that justify a bounded operator test without presuming capability.

classes.label: False-positive outsider controls
classes.purpose: Control fixtures that test whether grievance, rejection, accident, or discipline is being mistaken for capability.

classes.label: Ordinary specialists
classes.purpose: Bounded specialist traces that prevent cross-domain breadth from becoming an automatic bonus and specialization from becoming an automatic penalty.

classes.label: High-status selected operators
classes.purpose: Formal-role comparators that prevent low legibility from becoming an automatic bonus and status from becoming an automatic disqualifier.

classes.label: Repair-capable partnership traces
classes.purpose: Observed or designed correction routes that may preserve standing, evidence, reversal, remedy, or resumability.

classes.label: Brittle or failed partnership traces
classes.purpose: Relationship and institutional fixtures where contradiction, custody, or authorship transfer may have broken the working system.

source_routes.role: source-custodied gate, control, correction, and non-event observations
parent hypothesis and role-neutral denominator precedent
source_routes.effect: no prevalence, motive, coordination, or actor-edge inference

protocol_history.supersession_reason: Wave 00 numeric zero conflated not-observed and contradicted states; Wave 01 requires explicit not_tested state and forbids score assignment before bounded evidence and second-party review.
